## Validation

- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`

## Trust And Compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, account data, Vault paths, or server internals added
- [ ] Network, Vault, clipboard, payment, or account behavior is disclosed when changed
- [ ] Public sharing remains explicit
- [ ] The plugin remains mobile-compatible and introduces no Node.js/Electron runtime dependency
